name: Ooshima Akira
source:
The heroine from the first game. She was saved and taken away by Yuusuke before she was forced into an unwanted marriage to cover her father's debts.

When asked, “What do you like about Yusuke? She is the kind of girl who simply replies, “Everything."

She believes in Yusuke's hidden talent and is proud to be able to support him behind the scenes. She has the talent to brighten up a place just by being there.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=532785]Getchu[/url]]
